entry.value: Input table containing columns to process

Levene's test is used to assess the homogeneity of variances across groups. This metanode is using the leveneTest() function from the R cars package. Observations need to be independent, data in columns continuous.%%00010%%00010For a correct performance of the test, experimental design needs to be filled in corresponding form field in the form of sample type names in the same order as data columns without replicate number specification (e.g. "A,A,A,B,B,B,C,C,C"). Comparisons then need to only contain sample type names (e.g. "B-A, C-A").%%00010%%00010Rows will be uniquely identified by values in the row identifier column (e.g. protein group column in protein table or sequence column in peptide table).%%00010%%00010It is also possible to to filter out rows based on the minimal number of valid values in at least one sample type. One can use either single threshold for all samples or separate threshold for each sample.%%00010%%00010=================%%00010%%00010Used programs and tools and their respective licenses at the time of the metanode creation.
